task:
Make one narrow exact-head remediation on draft PR #578, current target head dca63ddd76d2d4b98a3197fb09222de91e108cbe. Work only on that existing branch, do not create another PR, do not merge, and do not reintroduce Playwright. Read CLAUDE.md and the PR acceptance policy first.

Exact observed failures and verified root causes:

1. Cypress Firefox: auth 3/3 and 15/16 release-gate tests pass. Only `opens and closes a system detail modal from a real search result` fails because the Escape event is dispatched as soon as the modal DOM is visible, but `SystemDetailModal` registers the window keydown listener in a React `useEffect`. The same effect sets `document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'`, so modal visibility alone is not readiness; Chrome happens to win the race, Firefox does not. Do not skip or browser-condition the assertion and do not replace it with clicking the close button.

Repair: in the shared Cypress Escape helper(s) and release-gate test, first retry/assert `document.body.style.overflow === 'hidden'` as the observable proof that the modal effect has installed its listener. Then dispatch a bubbling/cancelable `KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key:'Escape', code:'Escape', which:27, keyCode:27 })` on the AUT window and assert the modal is absent, body overflow is restored, and the hash/route is restored. Preserve the true keyboard contract. Add/adjust focused source/contract tests so the readiness signal must precede dispatch in both product parity and Review Lab.

2. Cypress Review Lab now completes the trusted Node-task handshake and writes a valid schema-v1 browser summary, but every profile aborts immediately in `finder()`. Exact fatal error: after opening `filter-module-system`, `cy.contains('label', 'Colony status').find('button,[role=combobox]')` finds nothing. Verified DOM: `components/ui/Select.tsx` renders `<label htmlFor={id}>` and the Radix `SelectPrimitive.Trigger` as its sibling, not descendant.

Repair: resolve the labelled control semantically and cross-browser safely. Read the label's `for` attribute, validate it is non-empty, and select the corresponding escaped-id element (or use another exact accessible-label query available without adding a large plugin). Assert it has combobox/button semantics, is visible and enabled, then click it. Select the exact `Any` option and continue the existing explicit search. Do not loosen the search journey or remove the Colony status reset. Add/adjust tests to lock the label-to-control relationship rather than the invalid descendant selector.

3. Preserve all existing Cypress-only protections: `allowCypressEnv:false`; Node-task Review Lab handshake; bounded summary output path; explicit ordinary product spec list; Chrome and Firefox; axe; visual screenshot; renderer ordering; Python schema/evaluators; no active Playwright dependency. Do not weaken Delta 503-to-provenance correlation or any profile/scenario requirement. The previous Review Lab failure code `DELTA_FALLBACK_NOT_TRIGGERED` is downstream of the finder abort; after fixing the selector, run the full collector and investigate only if Delta still fails.

4. Run focused Python contracts, frontend lint/format/unit checks, Chrome and Firefox product Cypress specs, and full Review Lab verification where feasible. Commit only the coherent remediation through the wrapper to the existing integration branch. No production, live DB, host, secret, DNS, deployment or recovery action.
